# How Much Improvement Do the Introduced Models Achieve Compared to the Previous Models?

## Executive Summary

The paper introduces two recurrent neural network architectures, the Long Short-Term Memory Recurrent Neural Tensor Network (LSTMRNTN) and the Gated Recurrent Unit Recurrent Neural Tensor Network (GRURNTN), and compares them against previous baseline models: the standard LSTM RNN (LSTMRNN) and the standard GRU RNN (GRURNN) ([Tjandra et al., n.d.](document_1.txt)). The main improvement claim is that combining gating mechanisms with tensor-product operations yields lower test scores on both character-level and word-level language modeling tasks on the Penn Treebank (PTB) corpus.
